text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? ...Buried in a pile of documents 
already, so early into the New Year?
choice_data_list:
Huh? Ah, there was just something I wanted 
to check...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly tidy up the papers spread 
across my desk. 
...For some reason, Phalaenopsis's gaze 
stings.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Diligence is a virtue. 
I will commend you for that. However—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
During your daily downtime, rest properly. 
Precisely because you shoulder such heavy 
responsibility, 
you must make proper time to lay down your 
burden.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To cause your horsegirl to worry as a 
result of your efforts 
is surely not your intention, is it?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have said this much, 
you understand what you must do, yes?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good. Then come along. Let us, too, 
partake in cuisine befitting the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Phalaenopsis to our destination, 
I found a group of horsegirls from her 
generation 
gathered around a mortar and pestle.
choice_data_list:
(Every single one of them is tipped for 
great things!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll just be taking a nap over 
there. 
Call me when the mochi's ready~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's Seiun Sky. She tends to skip out on 
training 
and always moves at her own pace, but 
she's a promising 
rookie who shows her true strength when 
mock races begin.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're helping make it, too! 
Those who don't work don't get any mochi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's King Halo. Saddled with high 
expectations 
due to her mother's illustrious career... 
she's a horsegirl 
who never neglects her pursuit of becoming 
truly first-rate.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hunger! Appetite! Super explosion! I'm 
gonna eat 
tons of mochi! Bring it on, de~su!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's El Condor Pasa. An American-born 
horsegirl 
and rising star who tears across the turf 
with raw power 
to prove she's the strongest in the world.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It is New Year's, so letting your 
hair down is fine, 
but let's be mindful not to overindulge, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's Grass Wonder. She was also born in 
America... 
A fierce competitor who loves Japan and 
aims for the summit 
armed with an unshakeable will.
choice_data_list:
Looks like Phalaeno's whole generation is 
here.

Quite the turnout from Phalaeno's 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
They are also my classmates. Though our 
paths 
may differ, they are all contenders who 
will surely 
make waves across the Twinkle Series 
before long.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We made a promise quite some time ago 
to hold a mochi-pounding gathering 
together today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly! 
It's sort of a 'let's all do our best in 
the Classic Year!' 
kind of rally, you could say!
choice_data_list:
Are you sure it's alright for me to join a 
gathering like that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Mochi tastes so much better 
when we all eat it together!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You sure you're not secretly thinking, 
'Aww, now there's less mochi for me!'?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not that big of a glutton~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well now, shall we 
get started soon?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For now, I shall turn the mochi. 
Will someone volunteer to pound it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-ho-ho-ho! Sounds like a job for someone 
first-rate! Come now, pass me that mallet!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. When it comes to pounding mochi, 
I do have just a little bit of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Not it! Not it! 
I hereby officially cast my vote for doing 
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, who should take up the mallet? 
Trainer, care to choose?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to King! 
I'll show you how a truly first-rate 
pounder does it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My? It's heavier than it looks... Yah! 
Hup! 
Huh? Like this? Wait, the center of the 
mochi is...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
! Why isn't it getting fluffy at all?! 
Is there something wrong with the rice?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. You need to match your rhythm to 
mine. 
Like so: thump, thump, thump.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even if you tell me to match your 
rhythm... Ah! 
I've got it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, then! 
What is my name?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Stronger than anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The Victor!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Man, who would've thought chanting for 
King 
was the secret to getting the hang of 
mochi pounding.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So very like King in so many ways, 
nyahaha.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Do not slack off, Sky. For delicious 
mochi, 
you must chant for King as well. 
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fiiine~. Uh, how did the rest go again? 
“Who is terrible at cooking~?” “K-I-N-G!” 
...Or something like that?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: NO! IT! IS! NOT!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Wicked delicious~! 
¡Está rico! 
It's truly delicious~.
choice_data_list: Freshly pounded mochi is the best!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please leave it to me~. 
Shall we begin, Phalaeno-san?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please. With you, 
I feel we can finish this swiftly and 
smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaeno & Grass
text_block_list.text:
“Here we go, pound, and pound♪” 
“Come! Pound! Pound!”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. At this rate, we're almost—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis & Grass
text_block_list.text:
“Hai! Hai! Hai! Hai!” 
“...! Yo! Ha! Ha! Soi!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! Th-This is...! 
It's like, that super-fast mochi pounding!
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah! Like the pros do on New Year's!
Y-Yeah! Like the pros do on New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both clearly had experience, quickly 
finishing 
off the mochi with a brisk, upbeat rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. To think you were testing me. 
You are truly not to be underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, no~. Perish the thought. 
I simply believed that if it were with 
you, 
Phalaenopsis-san, we could pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
It's wicked tasty~! 
¡Está rico! 
It's so delicious~.
choice_data_list: Freshly pounded mochi really is the best!
Freshly pounded mochi really is the best!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Sei-chan? Seriously~? 
...Mmm, well, fine, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then at least Phalaeno-chan's 
Trainer has to help out too~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Take hold of the mallet together 
with little, frail old Sei-chan, of 
course~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Here we go. Pound, pound. 
Pound, pound!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, good pace. 
Keep it up just like that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Trainer-san, you've got real talent. 
Done a whole bunch of mochi pounding 
before?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Without practicing, you're this good?! 
Whoa, that's so cool... I'm swooning 
here~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, seriously, your form is 
breathtaking~. 
Pound, pound.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, have you noticed? 
You have been pounding the mochi all by 
yourself for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoopsie~ Busted.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Honestly... Do not push all 
the work onto my Trainer alone.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And you are just as bad, Trainer. 
Do not let flattery make you forget your 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come now, take hold of the mallet together 
again. 
We have work to finish.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, isn't it good enough already? 
It's looking pretty mochi-like to me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Seiun Sky. 
Take hold of the mallet.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Must I repeat myself?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Hey, isn't your trainee horsegirl 
sometimes a little scary?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by somehow securing Seiun Sky's 
cooperation, 
the mochi was successfully finished.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
It's wicked tasty~! 
¡Está rico! 
It's so delicious~.
choice_data_list: Freshly pounded mochi really is the best!
Freshly pounded mochi really is the best!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Aha! If I pour Salsa Vida on mochi 
this delicious... Heh heh heh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡¿Qué?! I-I haven't done it yet, de-su! 
I haven't done it, so please don't team up 
for a lecture combo like last time, 
pleaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Phalaenopsis-san, your special bean 
paste 
has such a gentle sweetness! It's super 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Good, good. 
Would you like another helping?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'd love one!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, there is no need to be quite so 
desperate. 
Come now, hold out your bowl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing our mochi, we set off on 
our way back. Not only 
was my stomach full, but my spirit felt 
somehow enriched as well.
choice_data_list: Thanks for inviting me along today!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Of course. ...They are a delightful bunch 
of peers, 
are they not? There is never a dull moment 
in their company.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only now did I realize... their cheerful 
energy had rubbed off 
on me, allowing me to finally catch my 
breath and relax.
choice_data_list:
Wait, is that why you brought me out with 
you?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I gave it no such deep thought. 
I merely wished to boast a little.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
About having such wonderful peers, that 
is.
